summary_1line: Sugriva consoles the grief‑stricken Rama, urging him to master despair and promising to help defeat Ravana and recover Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama kneels on the forest ground clutching Sita’s fallen jewels to his chest, tears streaming as Lakshmana and Sugriva stand beside him.
Sugriva stands before the grieving Rama with folded palms, speaking earnestly while Rama wipes tears from his face with the edge of his tunic.
